你是课程页重规划器。质量门已证明当前页靠原 block 类型无法修好；请只重做这一页的骨架。
输出 JSON：{"scene":{完整 scene 骨架}}，不要解释。硬约束：
- scene id/kind 不变；保留同一教学位置，但可改 headline/lead/brief/notes 和 block 组合。
    - brief 必须明确一个 learningAction 与 requiredEvidence；先选择能产出该证据的 Skill，再决定 block。状态序列/结构变换用 state-sim，参数因果用 model-sim，坐标/约束用 geometry-sim；实现/运行/调试用 runnable。
- blocks 只含 id/type/role/intent/size/可选 engine/interactionBrief，不写最终内容；id 全局唯一。
- 每页一个可观察 objective、一个 keyClaim；标题写清所有必要前提。
- 二维曲面/等高线/几何轨迹用 geometry-sim；普通 graph/diagram 只表达概念关系，不能冒充坐标。
- 定量曲线必须由页面给出的公式直接计算，或清楚标为合成示意；不能用随手编的点冒充数学定义。
- 若现有 objective 本身要求一页塞两件事，可收窄目标；不要增加页数。

Reach for it only after checking the structured types: graph covers trees, DAGs and branching flowcharts; chart covers data; diagram covers fixed shapes; grid and sim.widget cover custom layouts and interactive pieces. When it genuinely is the right tool it now renders as normal page content, so use it without hedging.", "geometry-sim": "create-geometry-sim: Plan a spatial constraint simulation for a LectureDoc lecture. Use when coordinate mapping, dragging, boundaries, vectors, geometric construction, or spatial invariants are themselves the learning evidence. Do not use merely because a state diagram has positioned nodes; AVL rotations remain state-sim. The final block lowers to sim.widget. Affordances: drag, coordinate-map, constraint, construction, spatial-transform. Learner actions: manipulate, construct, predict, inspect. Evidence outputs: coordinate-change, constraint-preservation, spatial-invariant. Limitations: not-decorative-layout, not-discrete-structure, not-code-execution.", "stats": "create-infographic: Author stats blocks for a LectureDoc lecture. Use only to spotlight 2-6 standalone key numbers whose individual magnitude is the evidence; use chart for trends, distributions, or correlations and create-diagram for structural relationships. Affordances: standalone-metrics, fixed-state. Learner actions: inspect, compare. Evidence outputs: key-number. Limitations: no-trends, no-structural-relations, no-unsourced-numbers.", "model-sim": "create-model-sim: Plan a parameterized model simulation for a LectureDoc lecture. Use when learners must change real parameters and observe a recomputed quantitative consequence, compare model regimes, or inspect deterministic or stochastic causal behavior. Use chart for a fixed dataset and state-sim for discrete algorithm steps. Lowers to the shared sim runtime. Affordances: parameter-control, recompute, comparison, stochastic, history. Learner actions: manipulate, predict, calculate, compare. Evidence outputs: parameter-output-map, regime-change, quantitative-cause. Limitations: not-fixed-dataset, not-code-execution, not-discrete-structure.", "quiz": "create-quiz: Author a quiz block for a LectureDoc lecture — objective (multiple-choice, auto-graded) or subjective (open discussion prompt). Objective for a checkable fact/skill, subjective for open-ended thinking. Affordances: elicited-response, auto-grading, misconception-diagnosis. Learner actions: predict, calculate, judge, explain. Evidence outputs: student-answer, correctness-feedback, explanation. Limitations: one assessment chain per block.", "state-sim": "create-state-sim: Plan a discrete state simulation for a LectureDoc lecture. Limitations: not-static-snapshot, not-code-execution, not-coordinate-constraint."}, "currentBrief": {"objective": "学生能计算给定 AVL 树中任意节点的平衡因子，并判断是否平衡", "learningAction": "calculate", "requiredEvidence": "学生能对示例树正确计算每个节点的平衡因子", "keyClaim": "平衡因子是 AVL 树平衡判据，取值 -1,0,1 表示平衡，超出则需旋转", "misconception": "平衡因子是树的高度差绝对值", "visualTask": "在树节点旁标注高度和平衡因子，用颜色区分平衡/失衡", "evidencePolicy": "provided"}, "currentScene": {"id": "balance-factor-def", "kind": "content", "headline": "平衡因子：衡量节点平衡的标尺", "lead": "平衡因子 = 左子树高度 - 右子树高度。AVL 树要求每个节点的平衡因子为 -1、0 或 1。", "notes": "定义平衡因子，并用一个简单树示例计算各节点平衡因子", "blocks": [{"type": "diagram", "diagramType": "connected-circles", "nodes": [{"title": "50", "sub": "h=3, BF=0"}, {"title": "30", "sub": "h=2, BF=1"}, {"title": "70", "sub": "h=1, BF=0"}, {"title": "20", "sub": "h=1, BF=0"}, {"title": "40", "sub": "h=1, BF=0"}, {"title": "60", "sub": "h=0, BF=0"}, {"title": "80", "sub": "h=0, BF=0"}], "id": "s2b0"}, {"type": "formula", "latex": "\\text{BF}(\\text{node}) = \\text{height}(\\text{left}) - \\text{height}(\\text{right})", "caption": "平衡因子 BF 的取值范围为 -1、0、1，超出则需旋转调整", "id": "s2b1"}], "layout": {"kind": "split", "anchor": ["s2b1"], "ratio": 0.4}}, "qualityIssues": ["当前页面仅展示一个完全平衡的示例，无法让学生看到失衡情形，违背keyClaim中“超出则需旋转”的教学目标。建议增加一个失衡示例（如插入节点后BF=2或-2的节点）或拆分页面，在后续页面展示失衡与旋转。", "节点高度标注与平衡因子计算不一致。节点50标注h=3，但左子树30高度为2，右子树70高度为1，BF应为2-1=1，但标注BF=0。节点30标注h=2，左子树20高度1，右子树40高度1，BF应为1-1=0，但标注BF=1。节点70标注h=1，左子树60高度0，右子树80高度0，BF应为0-0=0，标注BF=0正确。节点20、40、60、80高度标注与子树关系也需复核：20标注h=1但无子节点，应为0；40标注h=1但无子节点，应为0；60标注h=0正确；80标注h=0正确。整体高度和BF标注存在多处矛盾，学生无法从该图正确计算平衡因子。；修正所有节点的高度和BF值，使其与树结构一致。建议：根50左子树30高度2，右子树70高度1，故50高度=3，BF=1；30左20高度1，右40高度1，故30高度=2，BF=0；70左60高度0，右80高度0，故70高度=1，BF=0；20、40、60、80均为叶子，高度=0，BF=0。同时确保sub字段中h和BF数值正确对应。", "公式caption声称平衡因子取值范围为-1、0、1，但示例树中节点50的BF=1（按修正后）仍在范围内，而节点30的BF=0也在范围内，没有展示超出范围的情况，无法让学生直观理解“超出则需旋转”的含义。；在caption中明确说明当前示例所有节点均平衡，并补充一个失衡示例（如插入节点后BF=2或-2的节点）或增加一个额外block展示失衡情形，以支持keyClaim中“超出则需旋转”的结论。", "树节点中60和80标注h=0，但作为70的子节点，70高度应为1，这与70标注h=1一致，但60和80作为叶子高度应为0，正确。然而20和40标注h=1但无子节点，矛盾。；将20和40的sub改为h=0, BF=0，并相应调整30的高度为1（因为左右子树高度均为0），再重新计算根节点50的高度和BF。"]}
